**4h**

This 3D CAD model shows a floor-standing speaker tower with a low-poly geometric design. The chiselled triangular facets create a modern look on the cabinet. It houses three vertically stacked circular drivers for multi-unit sound and features a pyramid peak at the top surface.

### 2026-10-23 – This CAD update shows a single speaker module integrated into a tall internal bracing frame. By scaling down to one driver, you have optimized the internal volume allocation, closely mimicking how hig

**4h**

This CAD update shows a single speaker module integrated into a tall internal bracing frame. By scaling down to one driver, you have optimized the internal volume allocation, closely mimicking how high-end acoustic systems use dedicated isolation chambers to prevent air leaks and resonance.
The open frame acts as a blueprint for adding acoustic dampening or panelling around the main speaker box, which will isolate vibration and tighten up the bass response.
